purpose: Inspect all SQLite plan rows for the benchmark's numeric range query before loading data
sqlite_binding: bundled SQLite through the repository's rusqlite dependency
schema: CREATE TABLE docs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, body TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(body))) WITHOUT ROWID; CREATE INDEX docs_number ON docs(json_extract(body,'$.number'));
unforced_query: SELECT id,body FROM docs WHERE json_extract(body,'$.number')>=?1 ORDER BY id
forced_query: SELECT id,body FROM docs INDEXED BY docs_number WHERE json_extract(body,'$.number')>=?1 ORDER BY id
forced_plan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
limitations: Plans were inspected on an empty in-memory database without ANALYZE, as in the benchmark's plan check; actual choices may differ with data and statistics.
